Applied.Outcome: 14 days; when the cache lapses the Desktop falls back to Free with a line in About, and nothing saved is locked away.

Replies.Text: A Desktop used only offline would lose its tier after 14 days. Is 14 days right, and should the Desktop keep working in Free when the cache lapses, or refuse to open? **Recommendation:** 14 days, and the Desktop falls back to Free with a line in About; nothing a person saved is ever locked away. Resolve with no reply to take the recommendation.
